nightly-bot: ALERT: nightly-eval run #2026 failed 3 prompt cohorts (short-text cohort) on model redwood-v2-int4-2026-03. Short/one-word prompts returned empty/very short token streams. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.dev/evals/2026-03
Maya: saw this first thing this morning, short prompts like 'Hi' and 'Thanks' produced either '' or just '\n'.
Priya: can repro locally with the int4 artifact. Re-ran with float16 artifact -> responses normal.
Jason: interesting. any tokenizer errors in the logs?
Maya: logs show no obvious tokenization exception. sample from logs:
```
Input: "Hello"
Tokens: [154, 28, 9]
Model output tokens: [50256]
Decoded: ""
```
Liam: 50256 is usually  token for our tokenizer, that looks like a stray end-of-text being emitted immediately. Could be kv cache/position offset bug after quantization kernel change. :eyes:
Priya: note we recently flipped the kernel selection to use tiled-attn for the int4 path in runtime v1.4. Might be a mismatch in positional bias layout.
Eva: can you check if it happens only for short sequences? maybe a batching/padding cornercase.
Maya: quick repro matrix I ran: batch sizes [1,8], seq len [4,16], prompt lens [1,3]. Failures only when prompt len <=2 and batch==1. Batch>1 looks fine.
Jason: that screams batch-indexing bug. Could also be that prefix cache isn't populated for single-example fastpath.
Liam: immediate mitigation: add a fallback rule in routing to prefer float16 variant for requests with input tokens <=2 until we fix. I can push a temporary policy.
Priya: I'll take ownership of triage. Initial severity P2 (degrades quality for low-latency micro prompts, limited cohort). Opening GH issue and will attach reproducible snippet + runtime trace.
Maya: assigned to Priya, +1 to fallback plan, also putting a canary to rollback int4 path for tonight's deploy if more hits show up.
Priya: triage next steps: 1) get model runtime trace for failing run (gdb/log spew) 2) reproduce with minimal docker image 3) bisect tiled-attn kernel change 4) propose patch or temporary kernel revert.
Eva: on call today, can help with traces after 11:00 PT.
Maya: will post sample failing request IDs to the GH issue.
nightly-bot: NOTE: alert includes 47 hits in the last 12h, cohort: short-text, users impacted: internal QA and a few early customers (~3).
Priya: marking follow-up meeting 30m to sync and decide rollback threshold. If hit count > 100 in next 6h escalate to P1.
Jason: thanks all. please add short reproduction command to the issue, e.g. `./eval_runner --model redwood-v2-int4-2026-03 --input "Hi" --seed 42 --batch 1`
Maya: added logs and sample in the GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/issues/4123.
Liam: implementing routing fallback now, will post when deployed. :thumbsup:
Priya: noted. will report back after trace collection.
Maya: thanks — tagging ops for visibility @L1-ops.
